title: Sammy Swims to the Island
moral: Being brave means trying, even when you feel a little scared.

beats.narration: Sammy the duckling lived by a quiet pond. The warm sun was shining on the water, and the reeds moved slowly in the breeze.
beats.prompt: Can you say the word: sun?

beats.narration: The other ducklings swam to a little island in the middle of the pond. Sammy stayed on the shore. The water looked very big to Sammy.
beats.prompt: How do you think Sammy feels?

beats.narration: Mama Duck came close to Sammy. Mama Duck said, you can go slowly, one small paddle at a time. Sammy put one foot in the water to start the swim.
beats.prompt: Can you say the word: swim?

beats.narration: Sammy paddled a little way. Then Sammy rested on a flat stone in the water. The stone was warm from the sun.
beats.prompt: Can you say the word: stone?

beats.narration: Sammy was almost at the island. The other ducklings called out, come on, Sammy, you can do it! Sammy kept paddling, slow and steady.
beats.prompt: What would you like to say to Sammy right now?

beats.narration: Sammy reached the island. Sammy felt a little scared at the start, but Sammy tried anyway. Sammy gave a big, proud smile.
beats.prompt: Can you say the word: smile?
